title: 第6章 骗子
novel_title: 开局废灵根，成了宗门团宠小师叔
content_zh:
顾念念抬起头，露出了一双怯生生的双眼。

    她缩着肩膀，声音里带着不安的颤音。

    “我不知道！”

    说话的男人一愣，随后拍着桌子露出狰狞的威胁神情。

    “不是说乞丐最会看人脸色，怎么？以为有个宗主之女的身份，就觉得自己不同了？”

    他抬起手，一把揪住了顾念念的衣领，将她高高的提了起来。

    碗筷摔在了地上，碎成了无数片。

    顾念念眸光下垂，刚刚还白嫩香甜的米饭，混入了瓷片和泥土，成了黑灰色。

    明明，他们也是不曾吃到好东西，竟能如此糟蹋。

    心里，有一个地方开始崩塌。

    可此时无人感知到。

    那人还在喋喋不休地威胁。

    “不说话？你不会还在做那个一年入门炼气期的白日梦吧？”

    说完，他自己先笑了，浓郁的嘲讽几乎要将顾念念整个人淹没。

    “一个废灵根，别说是一年，便是给你十年百年，都不可能踏入炼气期。”

    “前提是你能活那么久。”

    他将她狠狠地扔在了地上，破碎的瓷片扎进了顾念念的手心，鲜红的血液顷刻间染红了地面。

    男人视若无睹，居高临下地睨着她。

    “小丫头，给你指个明路。”

    “定期给程哥孝敬，以后在杂役院，没人敢动你。”

    程哥啃着鸡腿，一言不发，周身属于练气三层的气息此时却猛然散开。

    顾念念刚爬起的身体被这股威压冲得再次倒下，一口血从她口中喷出。

    男人哼笑一声，拿下顾念念放在凳子上的桃夭，转身恭敬地递给了程哥。

    他侧着头，露出半张阴森可怖的脸。

    “杂役院除了胡管事，所有杂役皆不允许有修为，但程哥是个例外。”

    “程哥是有靠山的，早晚有一天他会离开杂役院。”

    “小丫头，聪明人不会做傻事，识相点，对你只有好处没有坏处。”

    顾念念咬着下唇，眼眶红了，像是随时要哭出来。

    “那是洛师兄送我的，你不能拿走！”

    男人猛然皱起了眉，脸上已经满是怒气。

    那叫程哥的却伸手拦住了他，掂了颠手里的桃夭，一口咬断鸡腿，冷声说道：“她交代过，要低调！对付一个小娃儿，不要失了自己的身份。”

    男人立刻冷哼一声，收回欲要打顾念念的手。

    “小丫头，程哥仁慈，你最好也识相点。”

    程哥，也就是程鹏起身，扔掉手里的鸡腿，斜睨了一眼。

    “剩下的赏你们了。”

    连同男人在内的三人立刻喜出望外地道谢。

    程鹏又睨了顾念念一眼，朝地上啐了一口。

    其他三人则开始狼吞虎咽地吃了起来。
content_en:
Gu Niannian raised her head, revealing a pair of timid eyes.

    She hunched her shoulders, and there was an uneasy tremor in her voice.

    "I don't know!"

    The man who spoke was stunned for a moment, then slapped the table with a ferocious and threatening expression.

    "It's not that beggars are the best at judging people's faces, what? Do you think that because you have the identity of the daughter of the sect master, you feel that you are different?"

    He raised his hand, grabbed Gu Niannian's collar, and lifted her up high.

    The bowl and chopsticks fell to the ground and broke into countless pieces.

    Gu Niannian's eyes drooped. The rice, which was white, tender and sweet just now, was mixed with porcelain shards and soil, turning it into black and gray.

    Obviously, they have never eaten good food, so they can waste it like this.

    In my heart, something began to collapse.

    But no one noticed it at this time.

    The man was still spouting threats.

    "Don't talk? Are you still daydreaming about that one-year entry-level Qi refining period?"

    After saying that, he laughed first, and the rich sarcasm almost overwhelmed Gu Niannian's whole body.

    "With a waste spiritual root, let alone one year, even if it is given to you for ten or a hundred years, it is impossible for you to enter the Qi refining stage."

    "Only if you can survive that long."

    He threw her to the ground hard, the broken porcelain shards dug into Gu Niannian's palm, and the bright red blood instantly dyed the ground red.

    The man turned a blind eye and looked at her condescendingly.

    "Little girl, let me show you the way."

    "Pay filial piety to Brother Cheng regularly. From now on, no one will dare to touch you in the courtyard."

    Brother Cheng gnawed on the chicken leg without saying a word, but the aura that belonged to the third level of Qi training suddenly dispersed around him.

    Gu Niannian's body that had just climbed up was forced to fall down again by this coercion, and a mouthful of blood spurted out of her mouth.

    The man chuckled, took the Taoyao that Gu Niannian had placed on the stool, turned around and handed it to Brother Cheng respectfully.

    He tilted his head, revealing half of his ghastly face.

    "Except for Hu Guanshi, all the servants in the Courtyard are not allowed to have any cultivation skills, but Brother Cheng is an exception."

    "Brother Cheng has a backer. Sooner or later he will leave the courtyard."

    "Little girl, smart people will not do stupid things. If you are wise, it will only do you good and no harm."

    Gu Niannian bit her lower lip, her eyes were red, as if she was about to cry at any moment.

    "That was given to me by Senior Brother Luo, you can't take it away!"

    The man suddenly frowned, his face full of anger.

    The man named Brother Cheng reached out to stop him, weighed the Taoyao in Dian's hand, bit off the drumstick in one bite, and said coldly: "She told me to keep a low profile! Don't lose your identity when dealing with a little kid."

    The man immediately snorted coldly and took back the hand that was about to hit Gu Niannian.

    "Little girl, Brother Cheng is kind, you'd better be wiser."

    Brother Cheng, that is, Cheng Peng stood up, threw away the chicken drumstick in his hand, and glanced sideways.

    "I'll reward you with the rest."

    The three people, including the man, immediately thanked him overjoyed.

    Cheng Peng glanced at Gu Niannian again and spat on the ground.

    The other three began to eat hungrily.
